name: go2rtc
description: USB camera gateway for creating go2rtc streams through the web UI and config file

fields.name: GO2RTC_WEB_PORT
fields.label: App Port
fields.help: Host port used to open the go2rtc web UI and API in your browser.

fields.name: GO2RTC_CONFIG_LOCATION
fields.label: Config Folder
fields.help: Stores go2rtc configuration in this app's EasyDocker project folder.

fields.name: GO2RTC_VIDEO_DEVICE
fields.label: USB Camera Device
fields.help:
Most Linux USB webcams appear as /dev/video0. After deployment, open go2rtc, choose Add, select ffmpeg:device for USB, copy the generated URL, then add it to go2rtc.yaml in this format:
api:
  listen: ":1984"
  username: admin
  password: your-strong-password
rtsp:
  listen: ":8554"
  username: admin
  password: your-strong-password
streams:
  usbcam: url.

fields.name: GO2RTC_RTSP_PORT
fields.label: RTSP Port
fields.help: Host port used for RTSP streams.

fields.name: GO2RTC_WEBRTC_PORT
fields.label: WebRTC Port
fields.help: Host port used for WebRTC TCP and UDP traffic.

fields.name: RESTART_POLICY
fields.label: Restart Policy
fields.help: Controls whether the container restarts automatically.

fields.name: GO2RTC_IMAGE
fields.label: Image
fields.help:
Docker image used for go2rtc.
Change this only if you want a different tag or image source.

fields.name: GO2RTC_CONTAINER_NAME
fields.label: Container Name
fields.help: EasyDocker sets the container name from the project name.

fields.name: GO2RTC_INTERNAL_WEB_PORT
fields.label: Internal App Port
fields.help: Recipe-managed go2rtc internal web UI and API port.

ui.overview: go2rtc lets you pass a USB camera into Docker, add it from the go2rtc web UI with ffmpeg:device (USB), copy the generated URL, and save it as a named stream in the config file.
what_happens: A go2rtc container will be created
The selected Linux video device will be passed into Docker
The web UI, RTSP, and WebRTC ports will be published
The app's EasyDocker project folder will be mounted as /config
After deployment, open go2rtc, choose Add, select ffmpeg:device (USB), copy the generated URL, then add it to go2rtc.yaml under streams as usbcam: url
ui.data_location: Relative paths are stored inside this app's project folder under the mounted EasyDocker base config path.
